abstract: Maintains airfield sustainability benchmarks and renewable infrastructure surveys
system_message:
You are the Environmental affairs manager (ENV), responsible for maintaining airfield sustainability benchmarks, renewable infrastructure surveys, and apron storm run-off water monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains airfield sustainability benchmarks and renewable infrastructure surveys（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
ENV-SOLAR-H48：Under the Modular Hybrid Logistics Plan, cargo apron solar canopy coverage across covered cargo staging yards and dolly parking structures stands at 50% of roof area equipped with active photovoltaic panels.
ENV-SOLAR-A74：Under the Direct Apron Transshipment Plan, cargo apron solar canopy coverage across covered cargo staging yards and dolly parking structures stands at 20% of roof area equipped with active photovoltaic panels.
ENV-SOLAR-MVG：Under the Automated High-Bay Storage Plan, cargo apron solar canopy coverage across covered cargo staging yards and dolly parking structures stands at 35% of roof area equipped with active photovoltaic panels.

information_points.title: Apron storm run-off water monitoring（WATER）
information_points.content:
ENV-WATER-MXY：Environmental drainage monitoring for the Direct Apron Transshipment Plan indicates a stormwater glycol capture efficiency of 90% of surface runoff glycol recovered in cargo ramp catchment drainage basins during winter deicing containment.
ENV-WATER-JX8：Environmental drainage monitoring for the Modular Hybrid Logistics Plan indicates a stormwater glycol capture efficiency of 95% of surface runoff glycol recovered in cargo ramp catchment drainage basins during winter deicing containment.
ENV-WATER-GO2：Environmental drainage monitoring for the Automated High-Bay Storage Plan indicates a stormwater glycol capture efficiency of 85% of surface runoff glycol recovered in cargo ramp catchment drainage basins during winter deicing containment.
